method: Source trace of Notes read/write controls against current inventory and D61/D62/D63 reports; no runtime fault injection performed in this lane.

findings.user_impact: Opening a note during a detail-query error leaves the editor showing skeleton placeholders indefinitely. The only visible exit is Back; there is no error explanation or retry, so the note appears stuck and unavailable.
findings.source_mechanism: src/lib/notes/queries.ts:getNote returns null for Supabase errors and missing data. NoteEditor maps null to no note, and its `detailQuery.isPending || !note || !draft` branch renders the loading skeleton without inspecting detailQuery.isError. React Query retries by default, then remains in this branch after retries fail.
findings.existing_defect_overlap: Distinct from D61: that repair handles the list query and its error UI. The selected-note branch precedes that list error UI intentionally, while this independent detail query has no terminal error state. Not D62 create or D63 autosave.
findings.acceptance_reproduction: Open a listed note, inject a persistent error for the `workbench.notes` SELECT filtered by that note id, and wait for the detail query retries to finish. Expected after repair: an explicit detail-load error with retry and Back; current source remains on skeleton placeholders.

findings.user_impact: A delete whose filtered UPDATE matches zero rows is treated as successful: the editor closes and the note remains in the refreshed list, with no explanation that deletion was not confirmed.
findings.source_mechanism: softDeleteNote performs UPDATE ... eq(id) without selecting/counting affected rows and returns true whenever Supabase reports no error. Under RLS, a row hidden from UPDATE can yield a successful zero-row response. NoteEditor.performDelete interprets true as confirmed, invalidates the list, and clears selection.
findings.existing_defect_overlap: Distinct from D61/D62/D63. D62 concerns INSERT uncertainty and already avoids claiming persistence; this is a separate UPDATE result that currently claims success by navigating away.
findings.acceptance_reproduction: With a note open, configure the Notes UPDATE policy/test seam so the note id matches no updatable row while the request itself succeeds with zero affected rows. Confirm Delete. Expected after repair: remain in a recoverable editor state and show that deletion was not confirmed; current source closes the editor and the note remains listed.

runtime_verdict: Not runtime exercised; findings are source-level, with deterministic acceptance reproductions specified.
out_of_scope: listMyFolders has no callers in the current Notes flow; its empty-on-error behavior is not reported as a user-visible finding.
